hooks.command: { echo '# Project rules from AGENTS.md (auto-injected; Codex workflow and graphify sections excluded, graphify rules live in CLAUDE.md)'; awk '/<!-- BEGIN CODEX_ORCHESTRATION_WORKFLOW -->/{skip=1} /<!-- END CODEX_ORCHESTRATION_WORKFLOW -->/{skip=0; next} /^## /{g=($0=="## graphify")} !skip && !g' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/AGENTS.md"; } 2>/dev/null || true

{ for p in .workflow graphify-out .worktrees; do d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$p"; [ -d "$d" ] || continue; k=$(du -sk "$d" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1); [ "${k:-0}" -ge 8388608 ] && echo "WARNING: $p is $((k/1048576))GiB (warn 8GiB, .workflow limit 10GiB). Follow CLAUDE.md '.workflow 용량 관리' before starting new isolated runs."; done; } 2>/dev/null || true
